newsitem.title: USA: Hibernia to acquire Northwest Bancshares.
newsitem.headline: Hibernia to acquire Northwest Bancshares.

text.p: Hibernia Corp. said Friday it has agreed to acquire Northwest Bancshares of Louisiana Inc. in a stock deal valued at about $21 million.
After the deal closes, New Orleans-based Hibernia would have assets of $9.7 billion and 210 branches in 30 Louisiana parishes and five Texas counties.
Northwest Bancshares, a closely held company, operates First National Bank, which has two offices in Mansfield, its headquarters, and one each in Grand Cane, Logansport and Stonewall in Louisiana.
The merger, meant to be tax-free to shareholders, is expected to close by the end of the year. It is subject to approval by regulators and Northwest Bancshares shareholders.
Hibernia's stock fell 12.5 cents to $14 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
